Subject: Level-change packet for Priya N. — evidence window and committee cadence

Hi team,

I pulled together an initial draft of Priya's level-change packet and a lightweight evidence summary attached. Goal is to get this into the committee queue for the July 7 slot; we have one open advisor seat that week and I'd like us to be ready with redacted peer notes and the manager write-up finalized by EOD Thursday (6/17).

Please review the attached and flag any material you think should be removed or expanded. Specific asks:
- Marissa: can you confirm the impact bullets and add 2 measurable outcomes from Q2 (preferably with concrete PR/metric links)?
- Neha: can you check the calibration paragraph vs the other ICs we pitched last cycle and note any wording that might trigger a divergence request?
- Laura: can you confirm there are no outstanding conflict flags for committee members (I remember a possible overlap with a recruiting panel).

I want to avoid last-minute redlines from People Ops. If we land on Thursday, I'll hand the packet to Elaine (the external scheduling partner) to lock the committee slot and route the redacted peer notes. If anything looks sensitive, call it out in the thread and mark the file name as REDACTED.

Attachments: Priya_N_levelcase_v1.docx (manager write-up), evidence-summary-2027Q2.xlsx (metrics + links), peer-notes-redacted.pdf (currently marked REDACTED)

Thanks —
Markus

Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus. A couple of calibration notes after a quick pass:
1) The "scope expansion" bullet references a cross-team feature that hasn't shipped — I'd reframe to "led design and rollout" -> "drove spec and pilot; metrics pending". Committee tends to push back on items that present as complete when still in pilot.
2) There's one peer note that calls out headcount contribution by name; we should redact that before we hand to the committee (I marked it in the shared Drive).

Separately, I think it would help to give Elaine a 48-hour buffer to schedule the committee — their calendar is usually solid two weeks out in July. I'm copying Elaine's consultant (external) below so she can confirm availability.

Cc: Elaine Adams <elaine.adams@talent-advisors.com>

If Elaine confirms a July 7 opening, we can keep our Thursday cadence. Otherwise, I propose we aim for the July 14 slot and push the internal deadline to Monday 6/21.

-Neha

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Plan going forward:
- Marissa: final Q2 outcomes + links uploaded to the Drive by EOD 6/16 (received) — thanks.
- Neha: redaction noted; please remove the named headcount reference and re-upload the peer-notes-redacted.pdf.
- Laura: internal conflict check complete — no blocking conflicts.

Elaine confirmed that July 7 is very tight; the earliest guaranteed slot is July 14. Talent-scheduling has penciled us in for 14:30 PT on July 14 with the advisor panel. I've attached a calendar placeholder link in Notion and shared the packet link.

Action items:
- We shift the internal finalization deadline to Monday 6/21 COB. Please treat this as firm so we avoid a last-minute deferral.
- When you re-upload the redacted peer notes, append _REDACTED to the filename.

I'll forward the finalized packet to the committee contact (talent-scheduling) once all files are in Drive. If something legitimately can't be redacted (legal wording), flag it and we'll escalate to People Ops — I don't want surprises at review.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick work.

Markus
